book.title: 等我心情好了再说
book.subtitle: 一句有点磕巴的对不起

moral.zh: 重要的话，可以带着紧张说出来，也可以给彼此一点时间。
moral.en: You can say something important even while nervous, and give each other time.

pages.zhText: 安安和乐乐搭一座桥。乐乐刚摆好一块积木，安安就伸手拿走：“我要放在这里！”乐乐的桥倒了。
pages.enText: An'an and Lele were building a bridge. Just as Lele placed a block, An'an took it. “I need it here!” His bridge fell.

pages.enText: An'an had wanted to build faster, but she knocked down the bridge Lele had worked hard on. She heard the falling blocks and saw his face change.

pages.enText: Lele frowned. “You didn't ask me.” An'an felt upset too and turned away. They sat on opposite sides of the table.

pages.enText: At home, An'an thought about the fallen bridge. She knew she should apologize, but swallowed the words. “I'll say it when I feel better.”

pages.enText: Mom offered her some water. An'an slowly felt less angry, but the thought of speaking still made her stomach feel knotted.

pages.enText: The next day, An'an saw Lele in the neighborhood. She wanted to speak but looked down. As he walked away, she felt worse.

pages.enText: After listening, Mom asked, “What would you like Lele to know?” An'an said, “I do want to play with him. I know I should have asked before taking his block.”

pages.enText: When they met again, An'an stumbled through her apology. “Next time I'll ask before using your blocks. Is that okay?” Lele thought for a moment. “Okay. I needed some time too.”

pages.enText: Lele said he had felt sad when the bridge fell. An'an listened without rushing to explain. “I hear you. We can rebuild now, or later.”

pages.enText: They built the bridge again. An'an asked before reaching, and Lele passed her a block. As the bridge grew, the difficult words felt lighter.

parentGuide.goal: 练习具体道歉和行为补救，理解对方可以暂时不接受。
parentGuide.reminder: 不强迫立刻道歉或和好；等待是调节情绪的需要时应得到尊重。
questions: 安安想让乐乐知道什么？
除了说对不起，她还改变了什么？
parentGuide.activity: 用玩具演练借用前询问，以及说清具体行为、提出补救的道歉。

ageTips.age4to5: 先看表情和动作，说一说主人公的感受，再选一个小行动试试。
ageTips.age6to8: 讨论选择的原因和结果，也允许提出不同办法；联系自己经历过的一件小事。
